data.long_meaning: Maaziah is derived from the Arabic word 'Aziz', which means 'glorified' or 'praised'. It signifies a person who is highly respected and esteemed. The name Maaziah carries the meaning “Praise or Glorify” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maaziah usually hope their child will grow to embody praise or glorify and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the concept of praising and glorifying Allah is emphasized, reflecting the spiritual significance of the name Maaziah.
data.etymology: Maaziah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praise or Glorify.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maaziah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
